items.title: 《Agent评测白皮书》系列02：商家 AI 助手的评测与优化闭环实践

items.title: 如何在“不能出错”的系统里使用 AI Coding？分布式存储实践与边界
items.raw_text: 本文结合美团基础技术部在 AI 评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，分享 AI 能帮上什么忙、容易在哪些地方犯错，以及哪些地方仍需要人来把关。比「多写代码」更重要的，是让代码和结论经得起验证。
items.reason_zh: 分享在分布式存储等关键系统中使用AI Coding的实践与边界，强调验证的重要性，经验宝贵。
items.summary_zh: 本文结合美团基础技术部在AI评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，探讨了在“不能出错”的系统中使用AI Coding的可行性与边界。文章分析了AI能有效辅助的环节、容易出错的场景，以及仍需人工把关的关键点，强调让代码和结论经得起验证比单纯多写代码更重要，为高可靠性系统中的AI应用提供了实践参考。
items.title_zh: 如何在“不能出错”的系统里使用 AI Coding？分布式存储实践与边界

items.title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Neuronal Circuits
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2603.09600v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Brains remain unrivaled in their ability to recognize and generate complex spatiotemporal patterns. While AI is able to reproduce some of these capabilities, deep learning algorithms remain largely at odds with our current understanding of brain circuitry and dynamics. This is prominently the case for backpropagation through time (BPTT), the go-to algorithm for learning complex temporal dependencies. In this work we propose a general formalism to approximate BPTT in a controlled, biologically plausible manner. Our approach builds on, unifies and extends several previous approaches to local, time-continuous, phase-free spatiotemporal credit assignment based on principles of energy conservation and extremal action. Our starting point is a prospective energy function of neuronal states, from which we calculate real-time error dynamics for time-continuous neuronal networks. With this, as a first contribution we provide a simple and strai
items.reason_zh: 提出变分潜在平衡学习规则，试图替代BPTT并贴合神经回路动力学，理论与实验兼具，启发性强。
items.summary_zh: 大脑在识别与生成复杂时空模式上仍优于人工智能，而深度学习中的时间反向传播（BPTT）与现有对脑回路和动力学的理解存在明显冲突。作者提出变分潜在平衡（variational latent equilibrium）框架，用局部可计算的学习规则在神经元回路中实现时序信用分配，避免 BPTT 所需的全局误差反传与时间展开。论文给出理论推导并在序列学习任务上验证其可行性，讨论了该方法对理解生物学习与设计类脑算法的意义。
items.title_zh: 面向神经回路学习的变分潜在平衡

items.title: Directional Confusions Reveal Divergent Inductive Biases Through Rate-Distortion Geometry in Human and Machine Vision
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2604.21909v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Humans and modern vision models can reach similar classification accuracy while making systematically different kinds of mistakes -- differing not in how often they err, but in who gets mistaken for whom and in which direction. We show that these directional confusions reveal distinct inductive biases that are invisible to accuracy alone. Using matched human and deep vision model responses on a natural-image categorization task under 12 perturbation types, we quantify asymmetry in confusion matrices and link it to the shape of the information-error trade-off. We characterize this trade-off geometry using three signatures extracted from the rate-distortion (RD) frontier: slope beta, curvature kappa and efficiency (AUC). We find that humans exhibit broad but weak asymmetries, whereas deep vision models show sparser, stronger directional collapses. Robustness training reduces global asymmetry but fails to recover the human-like br
items.reason_zh: 用方向性混淆与率失真几何刻画人机视觉归纳偏置差异，超越准确率指标，分析视角有洞察力。
items.summary_zh: 人类与现代视觉模型可以达到相近的分类准确率，却犯下系统性不同的错误——差别不在错误频率，而在谁被误认成谁、朝哪个方向混淆。作者提出用方向性混淆矩阵刻画这种差异，并结合率失真几何分析，说明人机视觉系统具有不同的归纳偏置，而这些偏置在单一准确率指标下完全不可见。研究进一步将混淆方向与表征空间的几何结构联系起来，为比较人机视觉提供了新的度量框架。
items.title_zh: 方向性混淆通过率失真几何揭示人机视觉的不同归纳偏置

items.title: Local Spike Timing Enables Gradient-based Learning in Neural Microcircuits
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.08070v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: The brain uses discrete spikes for dynamic computation, yet in the fields of computational neuroscience and brain-inspired computing, how neural microcircuits (NMCs) solve temporal credit assignment using local spike timing remains a fundamental open question. Dominant spiking neural network (SNN) approaches circumvent this by approximating backpropagation through surrogate gradients, decoupling learning from biological spike timing. In order to integrate seemingly incompatible spike timing and continuous gradients, we reformulate temporal credit assignment as a state separation problem: extracting task-required components induced by historical perturbations directly from the current neural state. items.reason_zh: 探讨神经微回路如何用局部脉冲时序完成时序信用分配，为SNN摆脱替代梯度提供思路，理论价值高。
items.summary_zh: 大脑依靠离散脉冲进行动态计算，但神经微回路如何利用局部脉冲时序解决时序信用分配，仍是计算神经科学与类脑计算的核心难题。主流脉冲神经网络（SNN）通常通过近似梯度来绕开这一问题。本文提出一种基于局部脉冲时序的学习机制，使神经微回路无需全局反向传播即可完成基于梯度的学习。论文给出机制设计与理论分析，并在时序任务上验证其学习能力，讨论了该结果对理解生物学习规则与改进 SNN 训练的意义。
items.title_zh: 局部脉冲时序使神经微回路具备基于梯度的学习能力

items.title: Vision-Language Models Reproduce a Human Mental-Extrapolation Bias in the Watanabe Illusion
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.17741v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for visual judgments, yet whether they share human perceptual biases, and where in the model such biases arise, is unclear. We addressed this with the Watanabe Illusion, a stimulus not previously studied quantitatively: an oblique segment inside a circle whose extension geometrically hits the topmost of 11 dots, yet human observers (n = 131) reported a dot near the middle of the column. Five VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 7B, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5 Instant, Gemini 3.5 Flash), given the identical stimulus and wording, all deviated in the same direction. In the open-weight Qwen2.5-VL-32B, linear probes on the vision encoder recovered the line angle and the target dot six to eight times more accurately than its behavioral responses. A layer-wise logit lens showed that the correct answer dominates in the middle layers of the language model and is overwritten in late layers only under a visual
items.reason_zh: 用Watanabe错觉定量检验VLM是否复现人类知觉偏差，并定位偏差来源，属可解释性研究，值得关注。
items.summary_zh: 论文用此前未被定量研究的Watanabe错觉作为刺激，考察视觉语言模型（VLM）是否与人类共享知觉偏差，以及这种偏差在模型内部何处产生。实验让模型对圆内斜线段的延长线是否命中顶点作出判断，比较其与人类被试的系统性错误模式，并进一步分析偏差在模型各层与各模态间的表现。结果显示VLM会复现类似人类的心理外推偏差，说明其视觉判断并非纯几何推理，而带有与人类相似的先验倾向，为理解VLM视觉机制提供了新视角。
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型在Watanabe错觉中复现人类心理外推偏差

items.title: I spoke to seven physics experts grappling with the AI revolution
items.raw_text: AI can now do the calculations. What’s left for theoretical physicists?
items.reason_zh: 七位物理学家的第一手访谈，探讨AI接管计算后理论物理的定位，有反直觉洞察。
items.summary_zh: 作者采访了七位物理学专家，讨论AI对理论物理研究的冲击。当AI能够完成大量计算与推导工作后，理论物理学家还剩什么独特价值？受访者从研究范式、直觉与创造力、问题选择等角度给出不同看法，涉及AI在科学发现中的角色边界以及人类研究者不可替代的部分，是一组有思想深度的一线观点汇编。
items.title_zh: 我与七位物理学家聊了聊他们如何应对AI革命

items.title: Agent演示惊艳，一进生产就不好用：SAP直指企业AI落地的最大幻觉
items.reason_zh: SAP 视角拆解 Agent 演示与生产落地的鸿沟，对企业 AI 实践者有直接参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 文章围绕 SAP 对企业 AI 落地的观察展开，指出 Agent 在演示环境中表现惊艳，但进入真实生产环境后往往难以稳定可用。SAP 认为问题不在模型能力本身，而在于企业系统集成、数据质量、权限与合规、流程边界等工程与组织层面的约束。文章分析了演示场景与生产场景的差异，强调企业需要把 Agent 嵌入既有业务流程并建立可观测、可回滚的机制，而非追求单点炫技。对正在评估或推进 Agent 落地的团队，这是一份关于预期管理与工程现实的提醒。

items.title: AI safety legislation has a conflict-of-interest problem — Big US labs are warning of risk just as cheaper Chinese open-weight models erode their commercial edge
items.raw_text: The AI safety conversation is as much a political one as it is a real-life worry. We interview experts to find out how legislation may be a convenient way to control the AI market.
items.reason_zh: 探讨AI安全立法中的利益冲突问题，指出美国大实验室在廉价中国开源模型侵蚀其商业优势时警告风险，观点犀利，引发对AI监管背后动机的思考。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了AI安全立法中存在的利益冲突问题。随着更廉价的中国开源权重模型侵蚀美国大型AI实验室的商业优势，这些实验室开始警告AI风险，推动立法。专家访谈揭示了立法可能被用作控制AI市场的手段。文章分析了AI安全讨论背后的政治和经济动机，指出监管措施可能被既得利益者利用来维护市场地位，而非纯粹出于安全考虑。
items.title_zh: AI安全立法存在利益冲突问题——美国大型实验室在廉价中国开源模型侵蚀其商业优势之际警告风险

items.title: Windows 11 在记录你用过哪个 AI 编程助手
items.raw_text: 一位开发者在让 AI 帮忙翻 Windows 二进制文件时，在 MissionControlAggregator.dll 里翻到了一份名单：codex.exe、claude.exe、copilot.exe、cursor.exe，再往下还有 python.exe、dotnet.exe、gcc.exe、code.exe。 一个系统 DLL 为什么要认识编程助手？ 他把这个疑问追下去了。结论是：这个组件确实在记录你用过哪些 AI...
items.reason_zh: 从系统DLL里的进程名单顺藤摸瓜，揭示Windows对AI编程工具的监控，有调查性和隐私启示。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者在让AI协助分析Windows二进制文件时，于 MissionControlAggregator.dll 中发现一份进程名单，包含 codex.exe、claude.exe、copilot.exe、cursor.exe 以及 python.exe、gcc.exe 等开发工具。作者追查后确认该组件确实在记录用户使用过哪些AI编程助手。文章呈现了从发现线索到验证结论的调查过程，涉及系统级遥测与开发者隐私边界问题。

items.title: The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output
items.raw_text:
The US is tightening its chip export controls. Data centers in third countries like Singapore and Malaysia will soon need a US license to buy Nvidia chips, closing the loophole that let Chinese firms rent cloud compute abroad. A Reuters investigation also reveals how China offsets its hardware shortage through industrial-scale distillation of US AI models.

The article The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output appeared first on The Decoder.
items.reason_zh: 揭示美国芯片管制与中国平行供应链之间的博弈，对理解 AI 算力地缘格局有参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 美国正收紧芯片出口管制，计划要求新加坡、马来西亚等第三国数据中心购买 Nvidia 芯片时申请美国许可证，以堵住转口漏洞。文章同时指出，中国已借助美国 AI 输出构建起一条平行的供应链，单纯限制芯片租赁难以奏效。这反映出算力地缘竞争正从硬件出口延伸到海外数据中心与模型能力流动层面。
items.title_zh: 美国欲阻止中国在海外租用 AI 算力，但中国已借美国 AI 输出建成平行供应链
